dedupe_keys.name: dynamic models for building energy management

description: dm4bem publishes thermal-circuit and state-space examples for dynamic building-energy simulation. Its README describes a simplified building with five opaque walls, a glazed wall, infiltration and indoor temperature control, plus notebooks that obtain weather data, form differential-algebraic equations and simulate response to outdoor conditions. Users choose thermal properties, control settings and weather forcing; outputs include indoor temperature and heating or cooling response. The examples are generic buildings, not calibrated properties of a named site. GitHub metadata and the README state MIT licensing. A limitation is that the authors describe the example as a toy model and warn that manual assembly becomes tedious for large buildings. The equations can test control ideas and teach how a building heat balance maps to a state-space model before using more detailed building simulation. EnergyPlus in the catalogue provides a broader simulation engine. No notebook, weather series or numerical result was downloaded.
inputs: Thermal-circuit parameters, controls and weather forcing
